pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: The dark regions exhibit a complex, jagged polygonal or stellate geometry with sharp, acute-angled vertices. Edge gradients show a soft-to-moderate pixel transition between the dark interior and light borders. Spatial area of individual patches is relatively large on the mid-flank, becoming smaller and more densely packed toward the hindquarters.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: The negative-space pathways are light cream in color, forming a continuous topological graph. Junction nodes are primarily tri-radial and quad-radial. Pixel thickness of the pathways is inconsistent, narrowing significantly between adjacent acute patch vertices and widening at junction points.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane along the upper neck and shoulder exhibits a low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged silhouette. Individual hair tufts create a repetitive, saw-tooth geometric contour against the out-of-focus background.
